page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred lines: the title in large capitals with the author's name, then "TOMVS II.", then the italic description in four lines. The strip at the left edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: materiæ ad seriem Decalogi accommodatæ tractan-

page.notes: The title is set in large spaced capitals with mixed roman and italic lines. "A'" is printed with an apostrophe. The word after "aliaʒ" in the italic line is hard to read on the scan and may be "uarum" or "uariæ"; the [?] marks it as doubtful. The "COM=" at the end of the first line and "collecto-" with "rum," in the next are printed line-end breaks, rendered here as the title lines. The left edge strip is text of the facing page and was left out.
